verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic official SDKs (13 client-side, 13 server-side, 4 edge), with a specific Cloudflare edge SDK reference and official OpenFeature providers. Community users independently describe hands-on SDK behavior: clients download all flags on connect, then stream changes, and a mobile client SDK exists. missing for 10: per-language SDK reference docs beyond Cloudflare in the evidence, and AI-readable docs (llms.txt and docs.md probes returned 404).
